adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the third parameter is explicitly treated as a Cal.com user id (`calcomUserId: userId.toString()`). In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the call passes `credentialId` as that third argument (`refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)`), while other integrations in this diff consistently pass `credential.userId`. This would cause the sync endpoint payload to carry a credential id as `calcomUserId`, breaking the intended contract and likely mapping to the wrong/nonexistent user.
